Frequently Asked Questions

Expert guidance on Interior Partitions in Abu Dhabi.

Answers to common project and execution questions from our UAE site engineering team.

Can NASAQ install gypsum partitions without disturbing existing flooring?

Yes. Our team uses appropriate floor track installation techniques to preserve existing finishes wherever possible during partition installation.

What acoustic Sound Transmission Class (STC) ratings can your partitions achieve?

By combining staggered studs, dual-layer drywall, and acoustic rockwool density (50kg/m³), our partitions achieve acoustic insulation ratings of STC 48dB to 55dB.

Are your interior partition systems compliant with UAE Civil Defence fire codes?

Yes. We install fire-rated drywall partitions utilizing Type-X gypsum boards and intumescent acoustic sealants providing 60 to 120 minutes of verified fire resistance.
